subject: Final compliance sweep: marketplace listing imagery, support windows, and claims
messages:
From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@amazon.com>
To: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
Cc: AWS Marketplace QA <marketplace-qa@aws-partner.amazon.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Marketplace listing compliance: final items needed

Hi Lauren,

Thanks again for working with the AWS listing team. We're in the final review pass and have a short list of compliance items before we can publish the listing and enable co-sell badges. For this final sweep can you please provide the following by EOD Nov 29 (PST):

1) Approved marketing tile (1200x627 PNG) and logo SVG with clear guidance on allowed clearspace and color variants.
2) Formalized support coverage matrix (hours by region and response SLAs) in spreadsheet form. We need business-hour response times and escalation contact for P1/P2 incidents.
3) Exact claims language you want on the listing (no comparative claims, no guaranteed cost savings phrasing). We require one-paragraph factual statement + two bullet enablement details.
4) Confirmation you accept the standard AWS Marketplace listing terms for branding and logo usage.

A couple of notes from QA: the marketing tile must not include AWS logos; the title must not say "lowest latency" or any absolute superlatives without substantiation. See inline comments in the QA doc (attached).

If you prefer, we can take the assets you provide and do a quick compliance edit on our side (minor tweaks only). Once we receive the files and the confirmation, I can push the listing to final approval and trigger co-sell enablement.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Kim
Partner Manager, AWS Marketplace

Attachments: aws_final_pass_notes.pdf

From: Lauren Bishop <lauren.bishop@redwood.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Team — looping you in so we can hit AWS's EOD Nov 29 deadline. Action items below; I assigned owners but shout if that feels off.

Checklist (deliver before Nov 29 5pm PST):
- Marketing tile + logo variants (deliverable: 1200x627 PNG, SVGs, alt text) — Owner: Vanessa Ortiz — due Nov 27 EOD
- Support SLA matrix (deliverable: support_sla_matrix_v2.xlsx) — Owner: Marcus Lin — due Nov 27 EOD. Include response times by region (US/EU/APAC), on-call escalation, and contact emails/Phone Ops Pager.
- Claims statement (deliverable: claims_statement_v3.docx) — Owner: Marissa Cole — due Nov 26 EOD. Remove any absolute performance superlatives; include quantifiable measured statements only (e.g., median 95th pct latency on X test harness).
- Legal/branding confirmation (deliverable: signed acknowledgement) — Owner: Jonas Weber — due Nov 29 noon. Confirm acceptance of AWS usage guidelines and permitted marketing text.

Please use the Drive folder linked below for check-ins and upload final files. I will consolidate and send to Sarah on Nov 29. If anything slips, call me first.

Related links: https://drive.redwood.ai/shared/marketplace/listing-assets/2026-11

Thanks —
Lauren

Hi Sarah — following up with the consolidated package for final review. Per your checklist, we've attached the requested assets and provided the clarified claims and SLA commitments below. Please let us know if any small edits are needed on AWS's side; otherwise we accept AWS's standard logo usage guidance and listing terms.

Attachments attached to this message: redwood_marketplace_tile_1200x627.png; support_sla_matrix_v2.xlsx; claims_statement_v3.docx

Claims language (approved):
"Redwood Inference provides a high-throughput LLM inference platform that reduces per-token latency variability for production workloads. Typical 95th percentile generation latency on our benchmark (16k prompt, 2k gen, L2 cache warm) is X ms; refer to published performance profiles for model-specific numbers."

Support coverage (screenshot from support_sla_matrix_v2.xlsx):
- US: 24x7 monitoring, business-hours response (P1 within 1 hour, P2 within 4 hours), escalation to on-call engineering.
- EU: Business-hours support (Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00 CET), P1 within 2 hours, P2 within 6 hours; 24x7 critical incident coverage via on-call bridge.
- APAC: Business-hours support (Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00 SGT/AEST), P1 within 4 hours, P2 within 8 hours; priority routing to regional on-call.

Legal confirmation: Jonas Weber has added the signed acknowledgement to the Drive folder and confirmed acceptance of AWS branding rules (no AWS logo in our tile; no absolute unsubstantiated claims).

HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deals/AWSP-78932 — please confirm final approval and co-sell enablement when ready.

Thanks for the quick turnaround — happy to hop on a short call if you want to walk through any items.

Best,
Lauren Bishop

Redwood Inference
